name: Tandem & Co
summary: Near-black strategy consultancy site with two-tone white and grey headlines, an animated dot-matrix hero and moody 3D object renders.

fonts.pairing: medium grotesk headlines with the tail of each sentence greyed out; Instrument Serif only for tiny eyebrow labels and big stat numerals

signature: headlines split mid-sentence into white and neutral-400 grey
sticky services index on the left that highlights as each image card scrolls past
tiny '+ Label' serif eyebrows above every section
imagery: studio 3D renders and still-life objects on charcoal, one cinematic night street photo, rounded 20px frames
layout_grid: 1200px, 24px gutters, 112px section padding, left 1/3 label column, content in right 2/3
